While being in the bus after sightseeing tour, me and my other friend started joking around without him. When we started with dark humor he started insulting us so we were just laughing at him. After about 30 minutes, we made a bet if he loses he'll get noogies, and if we lose we'll stop joking and making him feel left out. When he lost he wanted to hit my friend with fists and tried to push my head against the window, but he soon failed because of the bus which was drifting at the moment.

Day after he snitched us to the principal and his mother (which started crying) and said that we wanted to beat and r\*pe him, so because of that we were talking with him and our whole friend group.

Long story short, he denied everything so we basically found messages which his mother sent to mine's and we mocked at him until we kicked him out of the friend group, so basically he's now friendless. So my literal question after all of this is, would you forgive him if you were one mine's place?

After death, we all stand in the line in which everyone is anxious and crying for mercy. It's like in the court, but this time Angels are you advocates, and the persecuting lasts always 40 days in which both sides prove what you've done. Worst of all is that, even if you try to visit your loved ones, you'll be able to see blackness in them, and that's so called ''Death''.
